title: Flatever - Flat illustration style [LORA/Krea 2]
description:
This LoRA was trained to produce flat-design images. The idea is to use as few lines as possible while keeping the visual clear, relying on solid blocks of color.

While the base model can already generate this style, I made an artistic choice that sets it apart from standard flat design. This choice also introduced a few biases, which may be corrected in the future if I feel like it.

For prompting, in addition to the trigger word, I suggest mentioning the colors and specifying a 2D, flat look to help avoid overly realistic and detailed generations. I hope you have fun with this model—it should be interesting to blend with some of your other favorite LoRAs. The example images were deliberately generated with the base model, but results may sometimes be better with less realistic, smoother models. Anyway, enjoy!

title: NullPop [LORA/Anima]
description:
Hello,

Some of you reached out asking if NullPop would make a return, sadly I no longer have the old lora or the previous data set used to create it. This is my attempt at recreating the NullPop based on what I had used previously and hope it helps you with your art generations.

The lora itself was trained with 99 images 1536x1536 with the Civitai Anima trainer at it's default settings.

Trigger Word: nullpop_style is the main trigger word for this style.

Secondary Trigger Words: colorful, high_contrast, limited palette, spot color, partially colored, sketch, thick outlines, linear hatching, hatching_(texture)

Secondary Trigger words are optional and were the original tags used to train this lora's dataset.

Epoch variants (early training of the lora) and the original dataset are also available to download as well.

ENGLISH

I created v1nt4g3 s4n4t0r1um as a journey through a fictional 1930s Alpine sanatorium palace, suspended in its last season. I wanted beautiful melancholy to emerge from the decor alone: discreetly worn oak, aged brass, crisp linen, mountain light and a pale-green-and-cream palette.

The set explores eleven spaces: the promenade gallery, hydrotherapy hall, rest hall, music room, dining hall, patient room, library, gymnasium, grand entry, rooftop solarium and snow park. Four compositions per space are followed by a final exterior synthesis. I kept every scene unoccupied, with no horror or franchise references.

Trigger: v1nt4g3 s4n4t0r1um
